$comment: KUMMIE badge enum. Closed set — no free-text badges. Every SKU carries exactly one 'sourcing' badge and at most one 'state' badge.

sourcing.meaning: Licensed/authentic product from a documented source
Own-brand product, original design, no third-party IP
Third-party IP used under a documented licence
Ships from the supplier, not from EU stock

state.meaning: Scarcity only. Bound to product.isLimited. Hot Pink appears nowhere else.
Held in EU fulfilment, no customs exposure
Not yet released; dispatch estimate required on the page

rules: Never invent a badge outside this enum.
Never use white text on Glow, Spotlight or Hot Pink at badge size.
Hot Pink is wired to exactly one boolean: product.isLimited.
Badges are translated; the enum id is never shown to users.
